rowText: Start a brand-new, empty chat while the panel is showing a Session context row from another chat, then press Down, Right, Left, Down, Up from the question box; a hit is Down/Right/Left/Down all failing to move and only Up escaping.

setup.prior_chat: a chat with 3 turns, Session context showing

steps.action: Moved to the new-chat [+] slot and pressed A quickly.
steps.observed: A ghost reply appeared first (the earlier chat's finished answer showing under the new chat, with Retry/Helpful/Copy reachable) -- this is the already-proven 'new chat shows the previous reply' bug, not tested further per instructions to skip it.

steps.action: Closed and reopened the panel to clear the ghost, confirming the new chat was then genuinely empty except a Session context (1 turn) row.
steps.observed: Empty, as expected -- close/reopen is the known fix.

steps.action: From the empty new chat, pressed Down three times in a row (Session context toggle -> the chip carousel).
steps.observed: Every Down press moved the ring to the next real control (Save-chat-area was skipped since this is a fresh chat with no saved messages; landed cleanly on the pinned test chip). No trap this try.

verdictSentence: This try did not reproduce the focus trap -- Down kept moving the highlighted control every time in this brand-new chat. Along the way the already-known ghost-reply bug showed up again by itself (not deliberately tried), confirming it is still there.
notes: A different, new focus problem was found tonight on Half-Life 2's Ask box after a chip was selected (Down and Right stopped moving the ring there, only Up worked) -- written up separately as plan61-ASKBAR-FOCUS-TRAP-01.json. That one is not this recipe's trap, but is the same family of D-pad-gets-stuck problem.
